summary: All planned features are implemented and passing: SloMetricsSummary dataclass with all 19 fields, 5 private query helpers, summarize_slo_metrics/summarize_slo_metrics_for_session functions, GET /v1/metrics/slo endpoint with SloMetricsSummaryResponse model, 9+ service-layer tests (including the monitor_completed_total vs completed_after_monitor_count distinction at line 1482-1483), and 5 API-layer tests. The previous iteration's bug in _count_monitor_completions (returning monitor_completed twice) has been fixed—the function now returns three distinct values with correct queries. Lint, typecheck, and all 51 focused tests pass. Minor documentation discrepancy: SloMetricsSummaryResponse descriptions for monitor_completed_total and completed_after_monitor_count (metrics.py:153-157) are identical and do not reflect their distinct semantics, but this does not affect behavior, test coverage, or backward compatibility.
